ca4a729678c7ee.s: Under the India–EU FTA, which group of Indian exports is expected to gain most, with about USD 33 billion of exports becoming duty-free?
o: Textiles, apparel, leather, footwear and gems and jewellery
ca4a729678c7ee.x: Labour-intensive sectors such as textiles, apparel, leather, footwear, marine products, gems and jewellery are expected to benefit from removal of 4–26% tariffs. Dairy, cereals, poultry and soymeal are protected sectors.

ca071d68ebce29.s: India and the GCC restarted FTA negotiations in February 2026 by signing the Terms of Reference in:
ca071d68ebce29.x: India and the GCC signed the Terms of Reference for the FTA in New Delhi, marking the restart of negotiations; Raja Al Marzouqi was the GCC chief negotiator.

ca5bfca6f937e3.s: From 1 January 2026, India assumed which position in International IDEA?
ca5bfca6f937e3.x: India assumed the chairmanship of International IDEA from 1 January 2026 at a Council meeting in Stockholm, represented by CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

caa74a72972878.s: Which of the following about India's roles in international bodies in 2026 is INCORRECT?
o: India became Chair of International IDEA from 1 January 2026.
India's UN Human Rights Council term runs from 2026 to 2028.
India was re-elected to the IMO Council in Category A.
ECOSOC marked its 80th anniversary on 23 January 2026.
caa74a72972878.x: India was re-elected to the IMO Council in Category B, not Category A, with 154 of 169 votes. The other statements are correct.

caef21a006bbfd.s: Which of the following pairs related to the Gaza Peace Council is INCORRECTLY matched?
caef21a006bbfd.x: The Gaza National Governing Council was a 15-member body, not 25. The council was announced on Truth Social, Mladenov was Executive Committee Director-General and Ajay Banga a member.

cad49a09db6f40.s: What institutional milestone did the UNESCO Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Alliance reach in January 2026?
o: It elected its Global Board for the first time
It held its first Global MIL Week
cad49a09db6f40.x: The UNESCO MIL Alliance elected its Global Board for the first time in January 2026. The Cartagena Declaration came from Global MIL Week 2025, and its 300+ membership is a separate detail.

caef2842ef7d50.s: The India–UK Offshore Wind Taskforce was launched at the:
caef2842ef7d50.x: The Offshore Wind Taskforce was launched at the 4th India–UK Energy Dialogue and operates under the India–UK Vision 2035 framework.

ca0e7d29910a4a.s: Which of the following about the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 is INCORRECT?
o: It is known as the "Seafarers' Bill of Rights".
It is regarded as the third pillar of international maritime law.
It is enforced through Flag State–Port State inspections.
It was adopted at the International Labour Conference in Geneva.
ca0e7d29910a4a.x: The MLC 2006 is regarded as the fourth pillar, not the third pillar, of international maritime law. It is enforced through Flag State–Port State inspections.

ca786d41156e2c.s: The India–UK Social Security Contributions Agreement avoids double social-security contributions for postings of up to:
ca786d41156e2c.x: The agreement, signed in New Delhi, avoids double social-security contributions for postings of up to 36 months.

ca77c04d4e9de3.s: Who signed the law legalising cryptocurrency mining and trading in Turkmenistan from January 2026?
ca77c04d4e9de3.x: Turkmenistan's President Serdar Berdimuhamedow signed the law; it took effect from January 2026 with licences issued by the central bank.

caa54951c9af3c.s: Which countries were elected as new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for 2026–27?
o: Bahrain, Colombia, DR Congo, Latvia and Somalia
Denmark, Greece, Pakistan, Panama and Somalia
Bahrain, Colombia, DR Congo, Latvia and Liberia
Algeria, Guyana, South Korea, Sierra Leone and Slovenia
caa54951c9af3c.x: The new members for 2026–27 are Bahrain, Colombia, DR Congo, Latvia and Liberia. Denmark, Greece, Pakistan, Panama and Somalia are continuing members.

caaac6e1ab1117.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Eurozone has 20 members.
2. Bulgaria is scheduled to join the Eurozone in 2027.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caaac6e1ab1117.x: Statement 1 is true: the Eurozone has 20 members. Statement 2 is false because Bulgaria is scheduled to join in 2026, not 2027.

caf50118241f02.s: On replacing the lev with the euro, Bulgaria became the ____ EU country to adopt the euro.
caf50118241f02.x: Bulgaria became the 21st EU country to adopt the euro after replacing the lev.

cacb5da04ee123.s: Which of the following pairs related to Oman is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Rub al-Khali – Mountain range in northern Oman
cacb5da04ee123.x: Rub al-Khali is the Empty Quarter; the mountain range in northern Oman is the Hajar Mountains. Muscat is the capital and Yemen borders Oman.

ca93e6aeae6976.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The India–Euratom Agreement covers both civilian and military nuclear cooperation.
2. Euratom has its headquarters in Geneva.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca93e6aeae6976.x: Both are false: India–Euratom cooperation is civilian only, and Euratom is headquartered in Brussels, not Geneva.

ca7262cf7e863d.s: Exercise Naseem Al Bahr is a bilateral naval exercise between India and:
ca7262cf7e863d.x: Naseem Al Bahr is the India–Oman bilateral naval exercise held since 1993; Oman was the first GCC country to hold a bilateral naval exercise with India. (Nearest honest shape: one-liner.)

caabe495ed8493.s: Which of the following about Ecuador's 60-day state of emergency is INCORRECT?
o: It was signed by President Daniel Noboa on 31 December.
It covered nine provinces and three municipalities.
It was declared in Ecuador, whose capital is Guayaquil.
It included the provinces of Guayas, Manabí and Pichincha.
caabe495ed8493.x: Ecuador's capital is Quito, not Guayaquil. The emergency, signed by Daniel Noboa, covered nine provinces and three municipalities.

ca4ee30e205707.s: The India AI Impact Expo 2026, inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi, was held at:
o: India International Convention Centre, New Delhi
ca4ee30e205707.x: PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the India AI Impact Expo on 16 February 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. Samudrika Auditorium was the venue for MILAN 2026.

ca58530de51abb.s: Which of the following about the mangrove clam breeding innovation is INCORRECT?
o: The species involved is Geloina erosa.
It is a bivalve of mangrove habitats.
It is called 'Kandal Kakka' in south Kerala.
ca58530de51abb.x: Geloina erosa is known as 'Kandal Kakka' in north Kerala, not south Kerala. ICAR-CMFRI achieved its induced breeding.

cac0e7381aa095.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IIT Kanpur developed a new method to predict solar cycles.
2. A solar cycle lasts about 11 years and involves the flipping of the Sun's magnetic poles.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac0e7381aa095.x: Both are true: IIT Kanpur developed the prediction method, and a solar cycle of about 11 years includes a reversal of the Sun's magnetic poles.

ca0e3e8948d954.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India consumes about 20% of the world's microprocessors.
2. Dhanush and Dhanush+ are the next variants associated with DHRUV64.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0e3e8948d954.x: Both are true: India consumes about 20% of the world's microprocessors, and Dhanush and Dhanush+ are the next DHRUV64 variants.

cab483bc415ebb.s: Exercise MILAN 2026 at Visakhapatnam was inaugurated by:
cab483bc415ebb.x: Rajnath Singh inaugurated MILAN 2026 at Samudrika Auditorium, Visakhapatnam. The President used INS Sumedha during the Fleet Review.

ca9bf699daadf9.s: Which of the following about the origin of Exercise MILAN is INCORRECT?
o: Its first edition was held at Visakhapatnam.
It was born under the Look East Policy.
Its first edition involved Indonesia, Singapore, Sri Lanka and Thailand.
ca9bf699daadf9.x: MILAN's first edition was held in 1995 at Port Blair, not Visakhapatnam. It originated under the Look East Policy.

caec3ad3b2ba6d.s: Exercise Khanjar-XIII, held at Misamari (Assam) in February 2026, was conducted by India with:
caec3ad3b2ba6d.x: Khanjar-XIII was held at Misamari, Assam, with Kyrgyzstan, involving India's Para Special Forces and Kyrgyzstan's Scorpion Brigade.

ca415acff6b58e.s: India hosted the UN Fellowship Training Programme on Small Arms and Light Weapons control, the first in Asia, at:
o: Military College of Materials Management, Jabalpur
ca415acff6b58e.x: The programme was conducted at the Military College of Materials Management, Jabalpur, an Indian Army institution.

ca852e3628f88b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Indian Army declared 2026 as the "Year of Networking & Data Centricity".
2. Radio Sangam was the Army's second community radio station near the Line of Control.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca852e3628f88b.x: Statement 1 is true (declared by Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi). Statement 2 is false: Radio Sangam was the Army's first community radio station near the LoC.

ca2b5f353f7a2e.s: What was the approximate value of the DAC-approved deal for 114 Rafale aircraft in February 2026?
ca2b5f353f7a2e.x: The DAC approved 114 Rafale aircraft at about ₹3.60 lakh crore. ₹7.85 lakh crore is the 2026–27 defence budget.

ca17358da79bdc.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Human cells have 4 tRNA genes.
2. PERT shows an efficiency of 10–20%, whereas HDR shows 60–80%.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca17358da79bdc.x: Both are false: human cells have 418 tRNA genes (4 identified as promising), and PERT shows 60–80% efficiency against 10–20% for HDR.

ca3134d8d205e7.s: The UN Fellowship Training Programme on Small Arms and Light Weapons control supports the UN Programme of Action (2001) and the:
ca3134d8d205e7.x: The programme supports the UN Programme of Action (2001) and the International Tracing Instrument (2005).

ca2445e0c48469.s: Which IIT developed a low-cost molybdenum–vanadium–sulphur–carbon electrode for green hydrogen production?
ca2445e0c48469.x: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad developed the electrode, cutting the cost from over ₹500 to below ₹50 per unit.

cadca0074e5ff7.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Army placed an order worth ₹186 crore for the MAPS UAV.
2. The MPATGM is a third-generation man-portable anti-tank guided missile tested at KK Ranges, Ahilyanagar.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cadca0074e5ff7.x: Statement 1 is false: the MAPS UAV order was worth ₹168 crore. Statement 2 is true.

caf25aa2c26a02.s: The ramjet-propelled artillery shell developed at IIT Madras is mainly intended to:
o: Extend the range of artillery fire
caf25aa2c26a02.x: The ramjet-propelled shell developed at IIT Madras is intended to extend the range of artillery fire.

ca3e3237e95c6b.s: Which organisation completed the indigenous upgrade of the IAF's Pechora surface-to-air missile system?
ca3e3237e95c6b.x: Alpha Design Technologies Ltd (ADTL), Bengaluru, completed the indigenous upgrade of the IAF's Pechora system.

caaad92d8caa48.s: Besides the Biological Weapons Convention, India is a member of which grouping related to biological security?
caaad92d8caa48.x: India is a member of the Biological Weapons Convention and the Australia Group.

ca30945d0c01c6.s: Which site at the lunar south pole was selected as the Chandrayaan-4 sample-return landing site?
o: MM-1 in the Mons Mouton region
MM-2 in the Mons Mouton region
MM-3 in the Mons Mouton region
MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region
ca30945d0c01c6.x: MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region was selected from 4 locations using OHRC images.

cacaa7e8caaddc.s: Which organisation relaxed the recognition norms for deep-tech startups under the Industrial Research and Development Promotion Programme (IRDPP)?
o: Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR)
cacaa7e8caaddc.x: DSIR implemented the relaxed recognition norms for deep-tech startups under IRDPP.

cad90f0c4b9196.s: Besides DRDO's 'Anvesh' satellite, the failed PSLV-C62 payload included satellites developed by:
cad90f0c4b9196.x: The PSLV-C62 payload included Dhruva Space satellites in addition to DRDO's 'Anvesh' surveillance satellite.

cadbe0e1501886.s: Which of the following pairs related to January 2026 defence developments is correctly matched?
o: Military Quantum Mission Policy Framework – Process begun on the Hooghly River
Haldia naval detachment – D4 Counter-Drone System
SKOCH Gold recognition – Four pillars including quantum computing
cadbe0e1501886.x: DIME was the first end-to-end logistics integration. The Quantum framework had four pillars, Haldia's process began on the Hooghly, and SKOCH Gold covered the D4 and Dharashakti systems.

cadc33d7a535a0.s: Matsya-6000, meant for human dives to 6,000 metres, is being developed under which mission?
o: National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems
cadc33d7a535a0.x: Matsya-6000 is being developed under the Deep Ocean Mission (Ministry of Earth Sciences, NIOT).

cac2969214c455.s: Who launched the Telangana AI Innovation Hub (TAIH) at WEF Davos on 20 January 2026?
cac2969214c455.x: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy launched TAIH at WEF Davos on 20 January 2026.

cab01923f7cd47.s: Which of the following about the improved SS3 stage of SSLV is INCORRECT?
o: Its motor case is made at the VSSC Composites Entity.
Casting and testing of the motor case are done at SDSC.
Its carbon-epoxy motor case gives a payload gain of about 500 kg.
It can provide a velocity of up to 4 km/s.
cab01923f7cd47.x: The carbon-epoxy motor case gives about 90 kg of payload gain; 500 kg is SSLV's approximate payload capacity to LEO.

caa0f59cc14416.s: Which condition is the largest contributor to neurological disability in India?
caa0f59cc14416.x: Stroke is identified as the largest contributor to neurological disability in India.

cac3fa092e0d4c.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. China's TPG-1000C microwave weapon can deliver about 2 GW for about 1 minute.
2. Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled a 3-nanometre Qualcomm chip in Bengaluru.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac3fa092e0d4c.x: Both are false: the TPG-1000C delivers about 20 GW for about 1 minute, and the Qualcomm chip unveiled was 2-nanometre.

ca366c67fddc61.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. DHRUV64 is based on the open-source RISC-V architecture.
2. DHRUV64 was the second chip fabricated under the Digital India RISC-V Programme.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca366c67fddc61.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: DHRUV64 was the third chip under the Digital India RISC-V Programme.

ca9fe3c33e4781.s: Which of the following about Biopharma SHAKTI is INCORRECT?
o: It has an outlay of ₹10,000 crore over 5 years.
It envisages more than 1,000 accredited clinical trial sites.
ca9fe3c33e4781.x: Biopharma SHAKTI includes 3 new NIPERs, not 5, along with 7 upgraded NIPERs.

ca8205c48c4feb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Zimbabwe began the lenacapavir rollout on 19 February 2025 at Epworth.
2. Lenacapavir is not a vaccine, is meant only for HIV-negative persons and does not replace ART.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8205c48c4feb.x: Statement 1 is false: the rollout began on 19 February 2026. Statement 2 is true.

ca3ed2caac52ea.s:
Consider the following statements about the indigenous tetanus and Td vaccines:
1. They were launched by J.P. Nadda at CRI Kasauli.
2. They were launched under UIP (1905).
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3ed2caac52ea.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: the UIP dates to 1985; 1905 is when CRI Kasauli was established.

ca373d0f08c7e8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bio-RIDE – Centres of Excellence at NIPERs
ca373d0f08c7e8.x: BioE3 (Biotechnology for Economy, Environment, Employment) was approved in August 2024. PRIP (2023, ₹5,000 crore) set up CoEs at NIPERs, and Bio-RIDE dates to September 2024.

cabad278eb3e2d.s: The study on the PERT genome-editing strategy, by the Broad Institute, Harvard and the University of Minnesota, was published in:
cabad278eb3e2d.x: The PERT study was published in Nature by the Broad Institute, Harvard and the University of Minnesota.

n724aabbc59c.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n724aabbc59c.x: Biopharma SHAKTI focuses on biologics and biosimilars. BioE3 is associated with biomanufacturing.

ca39418e60fd6f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Maia 200 was first deployed in Texas.
2. PATH-GENI is open-source software for studying ligand unbinding pathways and drug residence time.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca39418e60fd6f.x: Statement 1 is false: Maia 200 was first deployed in Iowa. Statement 2 is true.

ca64131f3430a3.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Heron Mk II has a payload capacity of up to 50 kg.
2. India and Israel Aerospace Industries are examining co-production of the Heron Mk II.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca64131f3430a3.x: Statement 1 is false: the payload capacity is up to 500 kg. Statement 2 is true.

caecd88417f9d1.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. China accounts for about 94% of global rare-earth separation and refining.
2. India has 5.7 million tonnes of rare-earth reserves (as REO).
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caecd88417f9d1.x: Both are false: China accounts for about 91% of separation and refining, and India has 6.9 million tonnes of reserves.

cab6a642ba3818.s: Which of the following pairs related to India's drone ecosystem is correctly matched?
o: Fixed-wing UAVs – Can hover and land vertically
Digital Sky Platform – PLI scheme for drone components
Heron, Predator and Reaper – Use engines rather than batteries
PLI scheme – Green, Yellow and Red airspace zones
cab6a642ba3818.x: Large UAVs such as Heron, Predator and Reaper use engines rather than batteries. Digital Sky is the single-window airspace portal with Green, Yellow and Red zones, and fixed-wing UAVs cannot hover.

ca1b4b8a7c70c9.s: Which of the following pairs of rare-earth applications and elements is correctly matched?
o: Lasers and fibre optics – Europium and terbium
ca1b4b8a7c70c9.x: Europium, terbium and yttrium are used in phosphors. Neodymium is used in magnets, neodymium and erbium in lasers, and lanthanum and cerium in refining catalysts.

caad241cea77fa.s: Which of the following pairs related to neurotechnology initiatives and laws is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Chile – Amended Constitution for mental integrity
caad241cea77fa.x: China is associated with the China Brain Project; the brain-data law belongs to California. The USA has the BRAIN Initiative and Chile amended its Constitution for mental integrity.

ca388bcfef0c30.s: Which of the following pairs of country/region and biosecurity measure is correctly matched?
ca388bcfef0c30.x: China has the Biosecurity Law (2021). The EU has the Health Security Framework (2022), Australia the Biosecurity Act (2015), and the USA the National Biodefense Strategy (2022–28).

ca8d40cdefeb84.s: The Chips to Startup (C2S) programme for semiconductor design talent was launched in 2022 by:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR)
ca8d40cdefeb84.x: MeitY launched the Chips to Startup programme in 2022 to develop semiconductor design talent.

ca1d61afdd79a6.s: Which of the following pairs of IIT-related developments is correctly matched?
o: 6G, NTN and quantum communication standards – IIT Delhi with CERC and Grid India
CoE for Power Sector Regulatory Affairs – IIT Kanpur with TEC
Catalyst Satellite Centre – IIT Mandi at Galgotias University
First media-tech startup accelerator – IIT Mandi
ca1d61afdd79a6.x: IIT Mandi's Catalyst Satellite Centre is at Galgotias University. IIT Kanpur–TEC covers 6G standards, IIT Delhi–CERC–Grid India the power CoE, and IIT Delhi FITT–WaveX the media-tech accelerator.

ca6006d9f6906a.x: JNPT, also known as Nhava Sheva, is India's largest container port, not Visakhapatnam. (Original's options were self-contradictory, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

cab38d76d165d4.s: Which of the following about drones is INCORRECT?
o: Heron, Predator and Reaper use engines rather than batteries.
Digital Sky is a single-window portal with Green, Yellow and Red airspace zones.
cab38d76d165d4.x: Fixed-wing UAVs cannot land vertically or hover. The other statements are correct.

o: Peak sunspots, flares and coronal mass ejections
A reversal of the Earth's magnetic poles
A complete absence of coronal mass ejections
ca25befaa447a0.x: Solar maximum is characterised by peak sunspots, flares and coronal mass ejections.

ca1922628170c9.s: Which of the following about the 1972 Liability Convention is INCORRECT?
o: It provides absolute liability for damage on the Earth's surface.
It provides fault-based liability for damage in outer space.
It provides fault-based liability for damage to aircraft in flight.
It distinguishes liability by whether damage occurs on Earth or in outer space.
ca1922628170c9.x: Liability for damage on Earth or to aircraft is absolute, not fault-based; fault-based liability applies to damage in outer space.

caad50ef997fc0.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Non-invasive Brain–Computer Interfaces include EEG headsets.
2. Invasive Brain–Computer Interfaces use EEG headsets rather than implanted electrodes.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caad50ef997fc0.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: invasive BCIs use implanted electrodes, not EEG headsets.

ca0711d685c17a.s: Which of the following pairs of neurotechnology application and use is correctly matched?
ca0711d685c17a.x: Spinal Cord Stimulation is used for chronic pain. Responsive Neurostimulation treats epileptic seizures and retinal implants address retinitis pigmentosa.

ca0431c6a7a0da.s: Ricin, a toxin linked to reported terror attempts, is obtained from:
ca0431c6a7a0da.x: Ricin is a toxin obtained from castor.

ca27c4c8696ef3.s:
Consider the following statements about World Wetlands Day 2026:
1. It was observed on 2 February 2026.
2. Its theme was "Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage".
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca27c4c8696ef3.x: Both are true: World Wetlands Day 2026 was observed on 2 February with the theme "Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage".

ca9cf5563c611f.s: Cyclone Gezani (February 2026) made landfall on Madagascar's east coast near:
ca9cf5563c611f.x: Cyclone Gezani made landfall near the port city of Toamasina on Madagascar's east coast.

ca4dcb37f03490.s: Under MISHTI, how much mangrove area is targeted for restoration?
ca4dcb37f03490.x: MISHTI aims to restore 540 sq km of mangroves, with a sequestration potential of about 4.5 million tonnes of carbon.

ca16093f30153f.x: Wetlands International is a non-governmental organisation, not an intergovernmental body.

ca0416da9b8eff.s: Which of the following Ramsar site – location pairs is correctly matched?
ca0416da9b8eff.x: Chhari-Dhand is in Kutch, Gujarat. Patna Bird Sanctuary is in Etah (UP), Siliserh Lake in Alwar and Kopra Reservoir in Bilaspur.

cac5b9ad1f8a0c.s: Siang is the Indian stretch of which river?
cac5b9ad1f8a0c.x: Siang is the Indian stretch of the Yarlung Tsangpo.

ca5e47239e06ae.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Kaziranga National Park has the world's largest population of one-horned rhinoceros.
2. Kaziranga National Park is associated with the Brahmaputra river dolphin.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5e47239e06ae.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: the species mentioned is the Gangetic river dolphin.

caa33389d16b6f.s: Which of the following pairs related to the Vadhavan Port Project is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Distance from Mumbai – About 140 km north
Implementing partnership – JNPA and Maharashtra Maritime Board
Year Palghar was carved out of Thane – 2004
caa33389d16b6f.x: Palghar was carved out of Thane in 2014, not 2004. Vadhavan is about 140 km north of Mumbai with a natural depth of about 20 m.

ca613f43e41891.s: Which body declared 2026 the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists?
ca613f43e41891.x: The United Nations declared 2026 the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists.

n88e4a4f9f87.s: Which of the following pairs of cities are accredited Wetland Cities of India?
n88e4a4f9f87.x: Indore and Udaipur are India's accredited Wetland Cities; Indore is the first one mentioned.

cab1ebf3816f80.s: The DNA-based Synchronous All-India Population Estimation of elephants (2021–25) was conducted under Project Elephant by:
cab1ebf3816f80.x: The Wildlife Institute of India conducted the estimation under Project Elephant, which began in 1992.

cac189d7744ed6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The United Sangtam Likhum Pumji resolved to protect pangolins.
2. Goa became the second State after Kerala to publish a state bird atlas.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac189d7744ed6.x: Both are true: the Sangtam Naga body adopted the pangolin-protection resolution, and Goa became the second State after Kerala to publish a bird atlas.

ca9a7558a91f54.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Shivalik–Gangetic region recorded a major decline in elephant numbers.
2. Elephant herds are matriarchal, and gestation lasts 18–22 months.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9a7558a91f54.x: Statement 1 is false: the Shivalik–Gangetic region was nearly unchanged, while the Western Ghats and North-East declined. Statement 2 is true.

caac2b8d7b732b.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
caac2b8d7b732b.x: The ZSI is headquartered in Kolkata, not New Delhi. ZSI dates to 1916, BSI to 1890 and the Deep Ocean Mission to 2021.

caf58e5464b70e.s: Mayon volcano, whose eruption led to the evacuation of about 3,000 people, is in which Philippine province?
caf58e5464b70e.x: Mayon volcano is in Albay province on Luzon island in the Philippines.

cab52be92b83b4.s: Bannerghatta National Park, about 22 km south of Bengaluru, became a national park in:
cab52be92b83b4.x: Bannerghatta, in the Anekal hills, was a reserved forest in 1970 and became a national park in 1974.

ca983f01b674b6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Mount Bur Ni Telong is a 2,624 m stratovolcano.
2. Mount Bur Ni Telong is part of the Atlantic Ring of Fire.
3. The Red Sea lies between Africa and Arabia.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca983f01b674b6.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: Bur Ni Telong is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire.

caec2246bedc92.s: After five more products received GI tags, Tamil Nadu's total GI count rose to:
caec2246bedc92.x: Tamil Nadu's GI count rose to 74 after five products received GI tags.

ca6160c68a1233.s: Which of the following Tamil Nadu GI product – district pairs is correctly matched?
ca6160c68a1233.x: Kavindapadi nattu sakkarai is from Erode. Woraiyur sari is from Tiruchi, Ambasamudram Choppu Saman from Tirunelveli and Makkal Pathirangal from Namakkal.

ca02a3f4f04898.s: Which of the following about India's bioremediation efforts is INCORRECT?
o: India has unified national bioremediation standards.
The DBT Clean Technology Programme and CSIR–NEERI projects are part of these efforts.
An IIT developed cotton-based nanocomposite mats to mop up oil spills.
BCIL and Econirmal Biotech are firms in this field.
ca02a3f4f04898.x: India has no unified national bioremediation standards. The other statements are correct.

ca943098ca3908.s: Under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Centralised online portal – Oversight of landfills
Legacy dumpsites – Tracking of the full lifecycle
ca943098ca3908.x: Polluter Pays involves environmental compensation. The portal tracks the full lifecycle, legacy dumpsites are to be mapped by 31 October 2026, and District Collectors oversee landfills.

ca8dd1f7cd1752.s:
Consider the following statements about the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026:
1. They come into force on 1 April 2026 and replace the SWM Rules, 2022.
2. The waste hierarchy places prevention before reduction, reuse, recycling, recovery and disposal.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8dd1f7cd1752.x: Statement 1 is false: the 2026 Rules replace the SWM Rules, 2016, not 2022. Statement 2 is true.

caff73093269fc.s: Protests by about 20,000 people were held against which proposed port in Palghar district, Maharashtra?
caff73093269fc.x: About 20,000 people protested against the Vadhavan Port in Palghar, Maharashtra.

caa7872422f8bb.s: In its order of 16 February 2026, what did the NGT decide on the environmental clearance for the Great Nicobar Island Project?
o: Referred it to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs
caa7872422f8bb.x: The NGT upheld the environmental clearance, noting that adequate safeguards were in place.

ca633ed53966d8.s: Ratapani Tiger Reserve is to be renamed after which archaeologist, the discoverer of the Bhimbetka rock shelters?
ca633ed53966d8.x: The reserve is to be renamed after Dr. Vishnu Shridhar Wakankar, who discovered the Bhimbetka rock shelters.

cab34945bf3fb4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Kerala became the first State to declare a state microbe, Bacillus subtilis.
2. Bacillus subtilis is a Gram-positive, rod-shaped, spore-forming probiotic and a facultative aerobe.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab34945bf3fb4.x: Both are true: Kerala declared Bacillus subtilis its state microbe, and it has the features in statement 2.

cae1b997689de5.s: Which river is India's second-largest gharial habitat, with over 400 adult gharials recorded in 2025?
cae1b997689de5.x: The Gandak is India's second-largest gharial habitat; the Chambal is the largest, with over 2,400 gharials.

caf58389425942.s: Which of the following about the Supreme Court proceedings on the Aravalli range is INCORRECT?
o: The bench was headed by CJI Surya Kant.
An expert committee was to be constituted.
Protection of the Aravallis is part of Article 14 jurisprudence.
The Court extended the stay on its 20 November order on the new Aravalli definition.
caf58389425942.x: Protection of the Aravallis is part of Article 21 jurisprudence, not Article 14.

caf880de6ee546.s: In January 2026, the Central Empowered Committee recommended restoring the Bannerghatta Eco-Sensitive Zone to its extent of:
caf880de6ee546.x: The CEC recommended restoring the ESZ to its 2016 extent and scrapping the reduced 2020 notification. (Original's options were self-contradictory, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

cabba64a046fee.s:
Consider the following statements about the Aravalli restoration study:
1. The pilot covered four villages around Gurugram.
2. About 43% of households depend on Aravalli forests for fodder, fuelwood and medicinal plants.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cabba64a046fee.x: Both are true: the pilot was in four villages around Gurugram, and about 43% of households depend on Aravalli forests.

ca347fae2c77fa.s: Which of the following about the Supreme Court's Aravalli framework is INCORRECT?
o: The 100-metre rule excludes more than 90% of the landscape.
The Management Plan for Sustainable Mining covers only the 5-km green buffer.
A total ban was not imposed, as total bans can fuel illegal mining.
The 5-km green buffer belongs to the Aravalli Green Wall Project.
ca347fae2c77fa.x: The Management Plan for Sustainable Mining is to be prepared for the entire Aravalli range, not only the 5-km buffer.

cadeb3e1b96161.s: Which of the following Aravalli protection milestones is correctly matched?
o: November 2025 – Supreme Court ban on mining in Gurugram, Faridabad and Mewat
May 2024 – Halt on new mining leases
cadeb3e1b96161.x: New mining leases were halted in May 2024. The 2009 milestone was the mining ban in Gurugram, Faridabad and Mewat, and November 2025 brought the uniform 100-metre definition.

ca6b02e47e2aaa.s: The January 2026 study on poorly assessed GLOF risks in the Himalaya–Karakoram was published in:
ca6b02e47e2aaa.x: The study appeared in npj Natural Hazards and flagged about 1 million people downstream at risk.

ca232d559cfd2f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Calamaria mizoramensis is a non-venomous reed snake recorded from Mizoram.
2. Gegeneophis valmikii was recorded from the northern Western Ghats of Kerala.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca232d559cfd2f.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: Gegeneophis valmikii was recorded from the northern Western Ghats in Maharashtra.

caa0d8427069c7.s: Nagar Van Yojana, under which six urban forests were sanctioned in Telangana, is a scheme of which Union ministry?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
caa0d8427069c7.x: Nagar Van Yojana is a scheme of the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

ca47f121a6e462.s: During heatwaves in urban heat islands, urban birds are early victims mainly because they suffer:
ca47f121a6e462.x: Heatwaves in urban heat islands cause dehydration and collapse in urban birds, making them early victims.

cae0a87cbe78d2.s:
Consider the following statements about the NDMA guidelines and SOPs for Disaster Victim Identification (DVI):
1. They are India's first-ever national guidelines and SOPs for DVI.
2. They mandate mass autopsies.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae0a87cbe78d2.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: the guidelines discourage mass autopsies.

ca3c073ba0a34d.s: Which of the following was NOT among the disasters that prompted NDMA's national guidelines on Disaster Victim Identification?
ca3c073ba0a34d.x: The guidelines were prompted by the Air India crash in Ahmedabad, the Sangareddy chemical explosion, the Uttarakhand flash floods and the Delhi car bomb blast, not a Kolhapur grassland fire.

ca67763ed5ccc1.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Nagauri Ashwagandha from Nagaur, Rajasthan, received a GI tag.
2. It became Rajasthan's third agricultural GI after Sojat Mehndi.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca67763ed5ccc1.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: it became Rajasthan's second agricultural GI after Sojat Mehndi.

cabc71e84d5ff4.s: Pangolakha Wildlife Sanctuary, where a forest fire was reported, is located in:
cabc71e84d5ff4.x: The fire occurred in Pangolakha in East Sikkim near the India–China border, at about 13,000 feet.

cae7503c22304a.s: Which of the following pairs of water body connected to the Sea of Japan and strait is correctly matched?
o: Okhotsk Sea – Tsushima and Korea Straits
Inland Sea of Japan – La Perouse and Tatar Straits
cae7503c22304a.x: The Sea of Japan connects to the Pacific through the Tsugaru Strait. The East China Sea is reached via the Tsushima and Korea Straits, the Okhotsk Sea via La Perouse and Tatar, and the Inland Sea via Kanmon.

ca5f3b747a04f3.s: The Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH) region is popularly known as the:
ca5f3b747a04f3.x: The HKH region, spanning eight countries, is known as the "Third Pole".

cafd91d0d15ca6.s: Which of the following air-purifying plants is correctly matched with its scientific name?
cafd91d0d15ca6.x: Spider Plant is Chlorophytum comosum. Areca Palm is Dypsis lutescens, Weeping Fig is Ficus benjamina and Peace Lily is Spathiphyllum wallisii.

cad3bc6d6116d6.s: Which of the following city – landfill methane hotspot pairs is correctly matched?
cad3bc6d6116d6.x: Jawaharnagar is the Hyderabad hotspot. Delhi's are Ghazipur and Bhalswa, and Dhapa is in Kolkata.

ca73188e0302e7.s: A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) is best described as:
o: A gradual retreat of a lake-terminating glacier
Seasonal snowmelt causing a slow rise in river levels
A sudden surge with debris after the natural dam holding a glacial lake collapses
Flooding caused by heavy monsoon rain over a glacier
ca73188e0302e7.x: A GLOF occurs when the natural dam holding a glacial lake collapses, releasing a sudden surge of water and debris.

cacfc6ec901aef.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The dugong, called the "sea cow", is a herbivore dependent on seagrass.
2. In India, dugongs are found in the Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacfc6ec901aef.x: Both are true: Dugong dugon is the seagrass-dependent "sea cow", found in India in the Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay.

ca6026b9ccba61.s: Shiveluch, the Russian stratovolcano that erupted recently, is known for which kind of magma?
ca6026b9ccba61.x: Shiveluch is a stratovolcano with super-hydrous magma; its eruption sent ash up to about 9,000 m.

ca808d06401e0a.s:
Consider the following statements about the Mount Bur Ni Telong volcano alert:
1. Indonesia reduced the alert level after a surge in seismic activity.
2. Mount Bur Ni Telong is in Bener Meriah Regency, Aceh Province, Sumatra.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca808d06401e0a.x: Statement 1 is false: Indonesia raised the alert level and began evacuations. Statement 2 is true.

ca7f18d5e93d9a.s: Bargi Dam, which received a safety-related notice, is built on which river?
ca7f18d5e93d9a.x: Bargi Dam is built on the Narmada River.

cadf8ebe58db50.s: The Ghepang Ghat Glacial Lake, which grew by 178% between 1989 and 2022, is located in:
cadf8ebe58db50.x: Ghepang Ghat Glacial Lake is in Lahaul and Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, at about 4,068 m; ISRO reported its growth from 36.49 ha to 101.30 ha.

ca8323332d93ec.s: Futala (Telangkhedi) Lake, a man-made lake in Nagpur, was built in the 18th century under the:
ca8323332d93ec.x: Futala Lake is a man-made lake in Nagpur built under Bhonsle rule in the 18th century. (Original's two statements contradicted each other, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

ca237f77e7b595.s: How many JALAJ Livelihood Centres were inaugurated by the Union Jal Shakti Minister?
ca237f77e7b595.x: The minister inaugurated 25 JALAJ Livelihood Centres; 75 is the target.

ca1d18a66b9483.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. COPD is progressive and reversible.
2. Tobacco smoking is the leading cause of COPD, and COPD is confirmed by spirometry.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca1d18a66b9483.x: Statement 1 is false: COPD is progressive and irreversible. Statement 2 is true.

ca2665c7499099.s: Which scheme provides LPG for clean cooking to cut emissions from traditional stoves?
ca2665c7499099.x: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana provides LPG for clean cooking; traditional stoves emit black carbon and methane.

cadd7cc8ef6f8f.s: According to the Henley Passport Index 2026, the Indian passport gave visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to how many countries?
cadd7cc8ef6f8f.x: The Indian passport gave visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 56 countries; Singapore led with 192.

cab4da0c38268c.s: What was India's rank in the Global AI Vibrancy Ranking 2025?
cab4da0c38268c.x: India ranked 3rd in the Global AI Vibrancy Ranking 2025.

ca59adc20060bd.s: What was India's rank in the Network Readiness Index 2025?
ca59adc20060bd.x: India ranked 45th with a score of 54.43 in the NRI 2025, which covered 127 countries.

ca04fffb0f9a4c.s: Which of India's indicator ranks in the Network Readiness Index 2025 is INCORRECTLY matched?
ca04fffb0f9a4c.x: India ranked 2nd, not 1st, in FTTH. It was 1st in telecom service investment and AI scientific publications, and 2nd in mobile broadband traffic.

ca332542292976.s: The first Responsible Nations Index 2026 was launched by ex-President Ram Nath Kovind at:
ca332542292976.x: Ram Nath Kovind launched the index at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre; the World Intellectual Foundation is the organisation behind it.

ca136c8039ba54.s: Which country ranked first in the Responsible Nations Index 2026?
ca136c8039ba54.x: Singapore ranked first, Switzerland second and Denmark third. (Original's options contradicted each other, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

caa27edae4eb32.s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Firepower Index 2026:
1. Pakistan ranked 13th.
2. Bhutan ranked 145th and was the least-ranked country.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa27edae4eb32.x: Statement 1 is false: Pakistan ranked 14th. Statement 2 is true.

cab3f9ab654809.s: Which of the following about the Numbeo Safety Index 2026 is INCORRECT?
o: Qingdao topped the global city rankings.
India ranked 70th with a score of 55.8.
India was ranked the safest country.
Papua New Guinea, Venezuela and Haiti were among the least-safe countries.
cab3f9ab654809.x: The UAE, not India, was ranked the safest country; India ranked 70th with 55.8.

nbb7806edd9e.s: In the Network Readiness Index 2024, India ranked ____ out of 133 countries.
nbb7806edd9e.x: India ranked 49th of 133 in the NRI 2024, up from 79th in 2019.

nce0e9b4d22b.s:
Consider the following statements about India in the Network Readiness Index 2025:
1. India ranked 45th, improving by four places.
2. India ranked first in AI scientific publications.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nce0e9b4d22b.x: Both are true: India ranked 45th in NRI 2025, up four places, and was first in AI scientific publications.

ca7ec25e720702.s: According to the ILO's Employment and Social Trends 2026, global unemployment in 2026 was projected at:
ca7ec25e720702.x: Global unemployment was projected at 4.9% (about 186 million people) in 2026.

ca593454f539e4.s: Which organisation released the report "Cattle and Community in a Changing Climate (2026)"?
o: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
ca593454f539e4.x: CEEW released the report on 20 January 2026.

cac509b3942311.s: According to the WEF Global Risks Report 2026, the top short-term risk was:
cac509b3942311.x: Geo-economic confrontation was the top short-term risk; biodiversity loss and ecosystem collapse was the most severe long-term risk.

cac7c527bfaaa9.s: The Global Environment Outlook 2025 (GEO-7) was published by:
cac7c527bfaaa9.x: GEO-7 was published by UNEP and released at UNEP's 7th session in Nairobi.

cade5223df011c.s: In 2024, the record-high global temperature rise reached about:
cade5223df011c.x: Global temperature in 2024 reached 1.55°C, the highest ever. (Original's two statements differed only in this figure, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

ca8e23e11cffb5.s: How many of the world's eight million species are reported to be facing extinction?
ca8e23e11cffb5.x: One million of the world's eight million species are facing extinction. (Original assertion only restated this figure, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

ca20f75595547f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh had a 16.4% share of people aged 60 and above in 2026.
2. Telangana ranked fifth on ageing indicators.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca20f75595547f.x: Both are false: AP's share was 14.1% in 2026 (16.4% is the 2031 projection), and AP, not Telangana, ranked fifth; Telangana ranked tenth.

ca5535b28200e3.s: Andhra Pradesh, ranked 8th in 2022, rose to which rank in the NITI Aayog Export Preparedness Index 2024?
ca5535b28200e3.x: Andhra Pradesh rose from 20th (2020), 9th (2021) and 8th (2022) to 5th in 2024.

ca675372a84943.s:
Consider the following statements about the RBI report on population ageing:
1. Kerala and Tamil Nadu were already ageing in 2026.
2. Over half of the States are expected to be ageing by 2036.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca675372a84943.x: Both are true: Kerala and Tamil Nadu were already ageing in 2026, and by 2036 more than half of the States are expected to be ageing.

caac03911e12d8.s: Under the RBI's classification, a State is 'ageing' when its share of population aged 60 and above is:
caac03911e12d8.x: More than 15% is ageing, 10–15% is intermediate and less than 10% is young. (Original's options contradicted each other, so rewritten as a one-liner.)

cab961426e8f9b.s: Which of the following pairs about the cancer study and QS Best Student Cities 2026 is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Data year of the cancer study – 2022
Countries covered by the cancer study – 185
QS distinction – Most affordable student city
City identified in the QS finding – Mumbai
cab961426e8f9b.x: QS Best Student Cities 2026 identified New Delhi, not Mumbai, as the most affordable student city. The cancer study used 2022 data for 185 countries.

caae6eb19029b9.s: According to the Numbeo Safety Index 2026, India's safest city was:
caae6eb19029b9.x: Mangaluru was India's safest city with a score of 74.4 (46th globally), followed by Ahmedabad and Jaipur.

ca2707528fb515.s: In Avtar's City Inclusion Score ranking of 125 cities, which pair is correctly matched?
ca2707528fb515.x: Pune ranked 3rd. Bengaluru was 1st, Chennai 2nd and Hyderabad 4th.

ca49d208882eef.s:
Consider the following statements about Avtar's findings on cities for women:
1. Chennai topped social inclusion.
2. Bengaluru topped industrial inclusion.
3. Avtar is a Bengaluru-based organisation.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca49d208882eef.x: Chennai topped social inclusion and Bengaluru industrial inclusion; Avtar is Chennai-based, so statement 3 is wrong.

ca127601ab36ec.s: Which of the following pairs from the CEEW livestock study is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Enteric fermentation – Over 90% of livestock greenhouse gases
Crossbred cattle – About 28 kg of methane a year
ca127601ab36ec.x: Crossbred cattle emit about 43 kg of methane a year; 28 kg is the figure for indigenous cattle.

ca0a2634e6b1ac.s: Which of the following GEO-7 indicator – figure pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Climate-disaster cost – USD 143 billion a year
Premature pollution deaths – 7 million a year
ca0a2634e6b1ac.x: GEO-7 puts premature pollution deaths at 9 million a year, not 7 million.

ca183e5db1d6a3.s: Which of the following award – recipient pairs (February 2026) is correctly matched?
o: Bhavya Bharat Bhushan Award – Varkala Vijayalakshmi
ISCR Lifetime Achievement Award 2026 – Prof. Upendra Kaul
A.K. Ramanujan Translation Award – N. Rajam and S. Kiran Kumar
National Handloom Excellence Award – Sipra Mukherjee and Mrinmay Pramanik
ca183e5db1d6a3.x: Prof. Upendra Kaul received the ISCR Lifetime Achievement Award. N. Rajam and S. Kiran Kumar got the Bhavya Bharat Bhushan, Mukherjee and Pramanik the Ramanujan award, and Varkala Vijayalakshmi the Handloom award.

ca071db1d0e11f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's peacetime gallantry awards were instituted in 1952.
2. The Ashoka Chakra can be awarded to civilians too.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca071db1d0e11f.x: Both are true: peacetime gallantry awards date to 1952, and the Ashoka Chakra is open to civilians as well.

caeb1b1b47012e.s:
Consider the following statements about PM Modi and the Knesset:
1. He became the first Indian PM to receive the Speaker of the Knesset Medal.
2. He became the first Indian PM to address the Knesset.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caeb1b1b47012e.x: Both are true. (Rewritten as a 2-statement set because no clean same-kind decoys could be built.) The Grand Collar of Palestine (2018) was a separate earlier honour.

cab1a54456352f.s:
Consider the following statements about Rubal Nagi and the Global Teacher Prize 2025:
1. The prize was presented at the World Governments Summit in Dubai.
2. The prize amount was $2 million, meant for paid vocational training.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab1a54456352f.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: the prize was $1 million, meant for free vocational training.

caa4d336b2ea52.s: The Recording Academy has presented the Grammy Awards since:
caa4d336b2ea52.x: The Recording Academy has presented the Grammy Awards since 1957.

ca62a8eccc5b08.s: Dr. Chandrakant Lahariya received the Wiley Research Heroes Award 2025 in which category?
ca62a8eccc5b08.x: He won in the 'Impact Beyond Academia' category, the only Indian among five winners chosen from over 2,000 nominations.

cae1e07943073a.s: Which British-Indian actress was made a Dame in the New Year Honours by King Charles III?
cae1e07943073a.x: Actress Meera Syal was made a Dame; geneticist Prof. Meena Upadhyay was also made a Dame.

caaa69d6201973.s: Which of the following pairs about Prof. Nalini Joshi is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: First woman Professor of Mathematics – University of Sydney
Order associated with her distinction – Order of Australia
Year she was made an Officer – 2016
caaa69d6201973.x: Prof. Nalini Joshi's field is integrable systems, not number theory.

cab317d575df56.s: The 70th Filmfare Awards South (films of 2024) were held in:
cab317d575df56.x: The 70th Filmfare Awards South were held in Kochi, Kerala, with Kerala Tourism.

ca1f32e2ec984a.s: Who won the 1983 Oscar for Best Actor for Tender Mercies?
ca1f32e2ec984a.x: Robert Duvall won the 1983 Best Actor Oscar for Tender Mercies.

ca7ce4836ba701.s: Who hosted the 68th Grammy Awards at Crypto.com Arena, Los Angeles?
ca7ce4836ba701.x: Trevor Noah hosted the 68th Grammy Awards at Crypto.com Arena, Los Angeles.

cac9804198e8a9.s:
Consider the following statements about the Padmapani Award to Ilaiyaraaja:
1. He received it at the Ajanta Ellora International Film Festival.
2. The festival was held from 28 January to 1 February in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac9804198e8a9.x: Both are true: Ilaiyaraaja received the Padmapani Award at the Ajanta Ellora festival, held 28 January–1 February in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.

ca04b7b435dd35.s: Which 475-year-old Portuguese-era cathedral in Maharashtra received the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Cultural Heritage Conservation Award 2025?
o: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai
ca04b7b435dd35.x: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral in Vasai, a 475-year-old Portuguese-era structure, received the award.

ca8610c461a5ff.s: Which of the following about History That India Ignored (2nd ed.) is INCORRECT?
o: It was authored by Prem Prakash, Chairman of ANI.
It was published by Vitasta Publishing.
It was launched by Goa Governor Ashok Gajapathi Raju.
ca8610c461a5ff.x: The book was launched by Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant, not Governor Ashok Gajapathi Raju.

cac96580f6bad0.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tyler Prize 2026:
1. Dr. Toby Kiers received it for work on underground mycorrhizal fungal networks.
2. The Tyler Prize was established in 1973 and is administered by the University of Southern California.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac96580f6bad0.x: Both are true: Toby Kiers was honoured for mycorrhizal network research, and the prize (1973) is administered by USC.

cad20c09c8bb7a.s: Which of the following about the President's Police Colour conferred on Sikkim Police is INCORRECT?
o: It was conferred by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Sikkim became the 14th State to receive it.
It was announced by DGP Akshay Sachdeva and CM Prem Singh Tamang.
cad20c09c8bb7a.x: Sikkim became the 15th State, and the 3rd in the Northeast, to receive the honour, not the 14th.

ca429800861547.s: Which of the following book – person pairs is correctly matched?
o: Red Lines Redrawn: Operation Sindoor and India's New Normal – M. Venkaiah Naidu
Chalice of Ambrosia: Ram Janmabhoomi – Surendra Kumar Pachauri
Mukkalaina Swatantryam, Mana Rajyangam – Gen Upendra Dwivedi
ca429800861547.x: Chalice of Ambrosia is linked to Surendra Kumar Pachauri. Red Lines Redrawn is linked to Gen Upendra Dwivedi, the Telugu book to M. Venkaiah Naidu, and Palanivelu Guts to Dr. C. P. Palanivelu.

ca74490944ba1b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Agni Sarassulo Vikasinchina Kamalam – Droupadi Murmu was authored by Yarlagadda Lakshmi Prasad and launched at Andhra University.
2. Droupadi Murmu is the 14th President of India.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca74490944ba1b.x: Statement 1 is true. Statement 2 is false: Droupadi Murmu is the 15th President of India.

ca89b78e06f1e9.s: Who presented the National Energy Conservation Awards 2025 in New Delhi?
ca89b78e06f1e9.x: President Droupadi Murmu presented the awards, which are instituted by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.

ca0b77a34818c0.s: Whose statue, as the first and only Indian Governor-General, was unveiled at Rashtrapati Bhavan during the inaugural Rajaji Utsav?
ca0b77a34818c0.x: C. Rajagopalachari was the first and only Indian Governor-General; his statue was unveiled during Rajaji Utsav.

caf3461a5b6152.s: Which Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister died in an aircraft accident near Baramati in January 2026?
caf3461a5b6152.x: Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar died in an aircraft accident near Baramati.

caffeb1cfac9e3.s: Who authored the novel Ghost-Eye, dealing with reincarnation and Sundarbans conservation?
caffeb1cfac9e3.x: Amitav Ghosh authored Ghost-Eye, published by Fourth Estate.
